run_render: run the render function to produce RGB, depth, and segmentation outputs from a MuJoCo MJX model and data
run_render_vmap: run the render_vmap function to batch-render multiple worlds using JAX custom vmap
run_render_shim: run the _render_shim function to bridge JAX arrays to Warp render context buffers
run_render_jax_impl: run the _render_jax_impl function to execute JAX-based rendering with staged Warp arrays
review_render: review the render function that wraps _render_jax_impl with JAX custom batching and FFI marshaling
